rules.text: Ramps on an accessible route may be no steeper than 1 in 12 (4.76 degrees).
rules.fix: Rebuild the ramp at 1 in 12 or shallower, or add a lift.

rules.text: Doorways on an accessible route need at least 860 mm of clear opening. The same number applies to aisles.
rules.fix: Widen the opening, rehang the door, or move the obstruction.
